contexts.title: Member Community
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for the community life of a membership organization such as a makerspace, coworking space or club: members' public-facing profiles and the people in their care, documented projects, job and gig leads shared among members, wish lists of things the community asks for, and participants' evaluations of the activities they attended.

contexts.title: Nonprofit Finance
contexts.definition: Vocabulary for the money a small nonprofit pays out and the requests that lead to it: expense reimbursements to staff and volunteers, fees billed by contractors and instructors, their approval status, the general-ledger account they post to and the bill created in the accounting system.

concepts.definition: The self-described, public-facing side of a person who belongs to a community organization: display name, pronouns, photo, bio, links, interests, skills and what they are open to (mentoring, teaching, freelance work), plus who may see it. Distinct from the membership account that governs access and billing.

fields.name: member
fields.description: The membership account this profile belongs to

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Public name, may differ from legal name

fields.name: pronouns
fields.description: schema:pronouns, e.g. she/her

fields.name: namePronunciation
fields.description: Phonetic spelling of the name

fields.name: photo
fields.description: Headshot or avatar image

fields.name: bio
fields.description: Self-introduction to the community

fields.name: links
fields.description: Personal websites and profile links

fields.name: socialHandles
fields.description: Social-media usernames the organization may tag

fields.name: chatHandle
fields.description: User ID in the community chat workspace

fields.name: interests
fields.description: Areas of interest and skills the person wants to develop

fields.name: skills
fields.description: Things the person already knows how to do (schema:knowsAbout)

fields.name: availableFor
fields.description: What the person is open to being contacted for

fields.name: goals
fields.description: Why the person joined

fields.name: organizationAffiliations
fields.description: Companies or organizations the person is affiliated with

fields.name: school
fields.description: School attended, for students

fields.name: awards
fields.description: Community awards or recognitions shown on the profile

fields.name: selfIdentifiedCharacteristics
fields.description: Optional self-identification used for program eligibility (veteran, disability, displaced worker)

fields.name: discoverySource
fields.description: How the person first heard of the organization

fields.name: referredBy
fields.description: Existing member credited with the referral

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: Who may see the profile

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from a makerspace's Drupal site: config/field.field.profile.main.* (member bio, photo, links, instagram, areas of interest, interests, skills, availability, goal, company, title, occupation, school, awards, contact method, characteristics, discovery, referral, profile privacy, Slack ID) and config/field.field.user.user.field_pronoun_txt / field_user_name_pronunciation / user_picture; aligned with schema.org Person (pronouns, knowsAbout, jobTitle, affiliation, award) and ProfilePage. Access, billing and emergency-contact fields stay on Makerspace Member.

concepts.definition: A child, or an adult in someone's care, who takes part in an organization's activities under a registered guardian rather than on their own account: the guardian signs waivers on their behalf, other authorized adults may check them in, and turning eighteen prompts them to claim an account of their own.

fields.name: legalName
fields.description: Full legal name as used on the waiver

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.description: Used to flag the age-of-majority transition

fields.name: primaryGuardian
fields.description: Account of the guardian who registered the dependent

fields.name: coGuardians
fields.description: Other adults authorized to check the dependent in

fields.name: careNotes
fields.description: Allergies, accommodations and who else may bring them in

fields.name: waiverSignedAt
fields.description: When the guardian last signed the waiver on their behalf

fields.name: waiverVersion
fields.description: Waiver version signed on their behalf; re-sign when the current version is newer

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.profile.ward.* (legal name, DOB, co-guardians, notes, waiver signed at/version) and web/modules/custom/makerspace_member_navigator (MyGuestsController, WaiverVersionService: guardian one-tap check-in, waiver-on-behalf); also the 'Waiver on Behalf of Minor' and parent-waiver webforms. schema.org Person parent/children relation.

concepts.definition: Something one or more people designed and built, documented so others can follow or learn from it: a description, ordered build steps with images or video, design and finished photos, files, the tools, materials and equipment used, the skill level it needs and how far along it is.

fields.name: makers
fields.description: People who made it

fields.name: status
fields.description: e.g. idea, in progress, completed

fields.name: interests
fields.description: Areas of interest it relates to

fields.name: steps
fields.description: Ordered build steps (schema:HowToStep)

fields.name: designImages
fields.description: Images of the intended design

fields.name: completedImages
fields.description: Images of the finished result

fields.name: resourceFiles
fields.description: Patterns, CAD files and other downloads needed to repeat it

fields.name: supplies
fields.description: Materials consumed (schema:supply)

fields.name: equipmentUsed
fields.description: Shared machines used (schema:tool)

fields.name: requiredBadges
fields.description: Equipment badges needed to repeat it

fields.name: hoursSpent
fields.description: Time it took (schema:totalTime)

fields.name: advice
fields.description: Lessons learned for others

fields.name: supportStatement
fields.description: How contributions toward the project would be spent

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.node.project.* (description, advice, area of interest, completed/design images, equipment, hours, instructions, required badges, resources, skill level, status, steps, support statement, type) and paragraph.project_step_image/project_step_text (step title, text, image, video); aligned with schema.org HowTo (step, supply, tool, totalTime).

concepts.definition: An advertised opening for paid or volunteer work, from a full-time position to a one-off commission, shared with a community so suitable people can apply: what the work is, who is hiring, where, the pay or budget, how many people are needed, how to apply and its status.

fields.name: hiringOrganization
fields.description: Business or organization behind the request, if any

fields.name: employmentType
fields.description: e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, commission, volunteer

fields.name: occupationalCategories
fields.description: Trades or disciplines the work belongs to

fields.name: compensation
fields.description: Pay or budget as stated, e.g. $25/hour or $300 for the job

fields.name: schedule
fields.description: Deadline, start date or dates of the work, as stated

fields.name: url
fields.description: Full posting elsewhere

fields.name: status
fields.description: e.g. open, filled, expired

fields.name: intakeChannel
fields.description: How the posting arrived

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.node.job_posting.* (job description, organization, trades, where, pay, people needed, deadline or dates, how to apply, link, attachment, contact name/email/phone, job status, job type, came in through) and the 'Hire a Maker' webform; aligned with schema.org JobPosting (title, hiringOrganization, employmentType, occupationalCategory, jobLocation, baseSalary, totalJobOpenings, applicationContact, datePosted).

concepts.definition: A tool, capability, piece of infrastructure, activity or policy change that members ask their organization to acquire or adopt, with why it matters, an estimated cost, how many people back it, how it could be funded or donated, and where the decision stands.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Why the community wants it

fields.name: estimatedCost
fields.description: Purchase and installation estimate

fields.name: fundraiserUrl
fields.description: Fundraiser or donation page for it

fields.name: interests
fields.description: Areas of interest it serves

fields.name: supportCount
fields.description: Number of members who voted for it

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.node.wish.* (why, area of interest, cost, fundraiser link, image, wish status, wish type), the wish_vote flag counted in web/modules/custom/makerspace_dashboard/src/Controller/WorkBoardFeedController.php, and node author/created; the 'Item Donation Inquiry' webform is the donation side.

concepts.definition: One attendee's feedback after a workshop, meetup, coaching session, mentorship or multi-week program: overall rating, likelihood to recommend, what was most valuable, what to improve, confidence gained and whether they will continue, optionally with demographics for outcome reporting to funders.

fields.name: activityName
fields.description: Workshop, event or program evaluated

fields.name: activityId
fields.description: Identifier of the event or program, when known

fields.name: facilitatorName
fields.description: Instructor, coach or mentor evaluated

fields.name: overallRating
fields.description: 1 to 5

fields.name: recommendLikelihood
fields.description: 0 to 10, Net Promoter style

fields.name: aspectRatings
fields.description: Likert ratings of individual aspects (content, pace, instructor)

fields.name: confidenceGain
fields.description: Self-rated confidence after the activity, 1 to 5

fields.name: discoverySource
fields.description: How they heard about the activity

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Pattern shared by ~25 webforms on a makerspace site (config/webform.webform.evaluation, webform_26478 Event Evaluation, webform_1181 Event Feedback, webform_24054 Coach Evaluation, webform_8242 Facilitator Evaluation, webform_9283 Foundations Course Evaluation, gems_program_exit_survey, post_program_survey_pathway_to_t, webform_14335, webform_17973 mentor feedback): event/instructor, how heard, currently a member, likert rating, overall, most valuable, improvements, recommend likelihood, confidence, continue, demographics fieldset.

concepts.definition: A written rule an organization has adopted to guide how it and its members act, such as a safety rule, membership terms, a code of conduct or a financial control, kept as a versioned document with a category and a canonical source. Signatures to a version are recorded separately as attestations.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Published text of the current version

fields.name: sourceDocumentUrl
fields.description: Canonical document the text is published from

fields.name: version
fields.description: Revision number; attestations cite it

fields.name: lastSyncedAt
fields.description: When the text was last refreshed from its source

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.node.policy.* (body, category, Google Doc URL, last synced) and web/modules/custom/makerspace_policy_library (categories seeded in hook_install: Safety, Membership, Code of Conduct, Operations, Financial/Legal, Events/Programs; revision per content change); version matches board-governance/policy-attestation.policyVersion, whose 'policy' reference has no target concept yet.

concepts.definition: A request from a staff member, volunteer or instructor to be paid back for money they spent on the organization's behalf, with the amount, receipts, purpose and the account it should be charged to, moving through draft, approval and payment.

fields.name: payee
fields.description: Person to be paid

fields.name: payToContact
fields.description: Accounting-system contact to pay instead of the payee, e.g. their LLC

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total to be paid

fields.name: receipt
fields.description: Receipt or other documentation

fields.name: relatedEvent
fields.description: Event or class the payment relates to

fields.name: expenseAccount
fields.description: General-ledger account code it posts to

fields.name: accountingBillId
fields.description: ID of the bill created in the accounting system

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.payment_request.reimbursement.* (amount, attachment, description, event, payee, status, Xero account, Xero contact override, Xero invoice id) and web/modules/custom/xero_bills_sync (bills pushed to accounting as ACCPAY invoices); also webforms 95 'Reimbursement' and 26999 'Quarterly Health, Commuter and other Reimbursement'.

concepts.definition: A bill for services an independent contractor, such as an instructor or tradesperson, performed for an organization, charged at an hourly rate or a flat fee, which is approved and then entered into accounts payable for payment.

fields.name: payee
fields.description: Person to be paid

fields.name: payToContact
fields.description: Accounting-system contact to pay instead of the payee, e.g. their LLC

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total to be paid

fields.name: relatedEvent
fields.description: Event or class the payment relates to

fields.name: expenseAccount
fields.description: General-ledger account code it posts to

fields.name: accountingBillId
fields.description: ID of the bill created in the accounting system

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from config/field.field.payment_request.payment.* (amount, attachment, description, event, hourly rate, hours, payee, payment type, status, Xero account, Xero contact override, Xero invoice id), user.user.field_default_hourly_rate, and web/modules/custom/xero_bills_sync; webforms 17088 'Instructor Pay Request' and 621 'Vendor Payment Request'. schema.org Invoice (provider, paymentStatus, totalPaymentDue).
